v.t: O people, be conscious of your Lord. The quaking of the Hour is a tremendous thing
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha An-Nasu Attaqu Rabbakum 'Inna Zalzalata As-Sa`ati Shay'un `Azimun

v.t: On the Day when you will see it: every nursing mother will discard her infant, and every pregnant woman will abort her load, and you will see the people drunk, even though they are not drunk—but the punishment of God is severe
v.l: Yawma Tarawnaha Tadh/halu Kullu Murđi`atin `Amma 'Arđa`at Wa Tađa`u Kullu Dhati Hamlin Hamlaha Wa Tara An-Nasa Sukara Wa Ma Hum Bisukara Wa Lakinna `Adhaba Allahi Shadidun

v.t: Among the people is he who argues about God without knowledge, and follows every defiant devil
v.l: Wa Mina An-Nasi Man Yujadilu Fi Allahi Bighayri `Ilmin Wa Yattabi`u Kulla Shaytanin Maridin

v.t: It was decreed for him, that whoever follows him—he will misguide him, and lead him to the torment of the Blaze
v.l: Kutiba `Alayhi 'Annahu Man Tawallahu Fa'annahu Yuđilluhu Wa Yahdihi 'Ila `Adhabi As-Sa`iri

v.t: O people! If you are in doubt about the Resurrection—We created you from dust, then from a small drop, then from a clinging clot, then from a lump of flesh, partly developed and partly undeveloped. In order to clarify things for you. And We settle in the wombs whatever We will for a designated term, and then We bring you out as infants, until you reach your full strength. And some of you will pass away, and some of you will be returned to the vilest age, so that he may not know, after having known. And you see the earth still; but when We send down water on it, it vibrates, and swells, and grows all kinds of lovely pairs
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha An-Nasu 'In Kuntum Fi Raybin Mina Al-Ba`thi Fa'inna Khalaqnakum Min Turabin Thumma Min Nutfatin Thumma Min `Alaqatin Thumma Min Muđghatin Mukhallaqatin Wa Ghayri Mukhallaqatin Linubayyina Lakum Wa Nuqirru Fi Al-'Arhami Ma Nasha'u 'Ila 'Ajalin Musammaan Thumma Nukhrijukum Tiflaan Thumma Litablughu 'Ashuddakum Wa Minkum Man Yutawaffa Wa Minkum Man Yuraddu 'Ila 'Ardhali Al-`Umuri Likayla Ya`lama Min Ba`di `Ilmin Shay'aan Wa Tara Al-'Arđa Hamidatan Fa'idha 'Anzalna `Alayha Al-Ma'a Ahtazzat Wa Rabat Wa 'Anbatat Min Kulli Zawjin Bahijin

v.t: That is because God is the truth, and because He gives life to the dead, and because He is Capable of everything
v.l: Dhalika Bi'anna Allaha Huwa Al-Haqqu Wa 'Annahu Yuhyi Al-Mawta Wa 'Annahu `Ala Kulli Shay'in Qadirun

v.t: And because the Hour is coming—there is no doubt about it—and because God will resurrect those in the graves
v.l: Wa 'Anna As-Sa`ata 'Atiyatun La Rayba Fiha Wa 'Anna Allaha Yab`athu Man Fi Al-Quburi

v.t: And among the people is he who argues about God without knowledge, or guidance, or an enlightening scripture
v.l: Wa Mina An-Nasi Man Yujadilu Fi Allahi Bighayri `Ilmin Wa La Hudaan Wa La Kitabin Munirin

v.t: Turning aside in contempt, to lead away from the path of God. He will have humiliation in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection We will make him taste the agony of burning
v.l: Thaniya `Itfihi Liyuđilla `An Sabili Allahi Lahu Fi Ad-Dunya Khizyun Wa Nudhiquhu Yawma Al-Qiyamati `Adhaba Al-Hariqi
w: and We will make him taste

v.t: That is for what your hands have advanced, and because God is not unjust to the servants
v.l: Dhalika Bima Qaddamat Yadaka Wa 'Anna Allaha Laysa Bizallamin Lil`abidi

v.t: And among the people is he who worships God on edge. When something good comes his way, he is content with it. But when an ordeal strikes him, he makes a turnaround. He loses this world and the next. That is the obvious loss
v.l: Wa Mina An-Nasi Man Ya`budu Allaha `Ala Harfin Fa'in 'Asabahu Khayrun Atma'anna Bihi Wa 'In 'Asabat/hu Fitnatun Anqalaba `Ala Wajhihi Khasira Ad-Dunya Wa Al-'Akhirata Dhalika Huwa Al-Khusranu Al-Mubinu

v.t: He invokes, instead of God, what can neither harm him nor benefit him. That is the far straying
v.l: Yad`u Min Duni Allahi Ma La Yađurruhu Wa Ma La Yanfa`uhu Dhalika Huwa Ađ-Đalalu Al-Ba`idu

v.t: He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit. What a miserable master. What a miserable companion
v.l: Yad`u Laman Đarruhu 'Aqrabu Min Naf`ihi Labi'sa Al-Mawla Wa Labi'sa Al-`Ashiru

v.t: God will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds into Gardens beneath which rivers flow. God does whatever He wills
v.l: Inna Allaha Yudkhilu Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Jannatin Tajri Min Tahtiha Al-'Anharu 'Inna Allaha Yaf`alu Ma Yuridu

v.t: Whoever thinks that God will not help him in this life and in the Hereafter—let him turn to heaven, then sever, and see if his cunning eliminates what enrages him
v.l: Man Kana Yazunnu 'An Lan Yansurahu Allahu Fi Ad-Dunya Wa Al-'Akhirati Falyamdud Bisababin 'Ila As-Sama'i Thumma Liyaqta` Falyanzur Hal Yudh/hibanna Kayduhu Ma Yaghizu

v.t: Thus We revealed it as clarifying signs, and God guides whomever He wills
v.l: Wa Kadhalika 'Anzalnahu 'Ayatin Bayyinatin Wa 'Anna Allaha Yahdi Man Yuridu

v.t: Those who believe, and those who are Jewish, and the Sabeans, and the Christians, and the Zoroastrians, and the Polytheists—God will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. God is witness to all things
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa Al-Ladhina Hadu Wa As-Sabi'ina Wa An-Nasara Wa Al-Majusa Wa Al-Ladhina 'Ashraku 'Inna Allaha Yafsilu Baynahum Yawma Al-Qiyamati 'Inna Allaha `Ala Kulli Shay'in Shahidun

v.t: Do you not realize that to God prostrates everyone in the heavens and everyone on earth, and the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and the mountains, and the trees, and the animals, and many of the people? But many are justly deserving of punishment. Whomever God shames, there is none to honor him. God does whatever He wills
v.l: Alam Tara 'Anna Allaha Yasjudu Lahu Man Fi As-Samawati Wa Man Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Ash-Shamsu Wa Al-Qamaru Wa An-Nujumu Wa Al-Jibalu Wa Ash-Shajaru Wa Ad-Dawabbu Wa Kathirun Mina An-Nasi Wa Kathirun Haqqa `Alayhi Al-`Adhabu Wa Man Yuhini Allahu Fama Lahu Min Mukrimin 'Inna Allaha Yaf`alu Ma Yasha'u

v.t: Here are two adversaries feuding regarding their Lord. As for those who disbelieve, garments of fire will be tailored for them, and scalding water will be poured over their heads
v.l: Hadhani Khasmani Akhtasamu Fi Rabbihim Fa-Al-Ladhina Kafaru Qutti`at Lahum Thiyabun Min Narin Yusabbu Min Fawqi Ru'usihimu Al-Hamimu

v.t: Melting their insides and their skins
v.l: Yusharu Bihi Ma Fi Butunihim Wa Al-Juludu

v.t: And they will have maces of iron
v.l: Wa Lahum Maqami`u Min Hadidin

v.t: Whenever they try to escape the gloom, they will be driven back to it: “Taste the suffering of burning.”
v.l: Kullama 'Aradu 'An Yakhruju Minha Min Ghammin 'U`idu Fiha Wa Dhuqu `Adhaba Al-Hariqi

v.t: But God will admit those who believe and do good deeds into Gardens beneath which rivers flow. They will be decorated therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be of silk
v.l: Inna Allaha Yudkhilu Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Jannatin Tajri Min Tahtiha Al-'Anharu Yuhallawna Fiha Min 'Asawira Min Dhahabin Wa Lu'ulu'uaan Wa Libasuhum Fiha Harirun

v.t: They were guided to purity of speech. They were guided to the path of the Most Praised
v.l: Wa Hudu 'Ila At-Tayyibi Mina Al-Qawli Wa Hudu 'Ila Sirati Al-Hamidi

v.t: As for those who disbelieve and repel from God’s path and from the Sacred Mosque—which We have designated for all mankind equally, whether residing therein or passing through—and seek to commit sacrilege therein—We will make him taste of a painful punishment
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina Kafaru Wa Yasudduna `An Sabili Allahi Wa Al-Masjidi Al-Harami Al-Ladhi Ja`alnahu Lilnnasi Sawa'an Al-`Akifu Fihi Wa Al-Badi Wa Man Yurid Fihi Bi'ilhadin Bizulmin Nudhiqhu Min `Adhabin 'Alimin

v.t: We showed Abraham the location of the House: “Do not associate anything with Me; and purify My House for those who circle around, and those who stand to pray, and those who kneel and prostrate.”
v.l: Wa 'Idh Bawwa'na Li'ibrahima Makana Al-Bayti 'An La Tushrik Bi Shay'aan Wa Tahhir Baytiya Liltta'ifina Wa Al-Qa'imina Wa Ar-Rukka`i As-Sujudi

v.t: And announce the pilgrimage to humanity. They will come to you on foot, and on every transport. They will come from every distant point
v.l: Wa 'Adhin Fi An-Nasi Bil-Hajji Ya'tuka Rijalaan Wa `Ala Kulli Đamirin Ya'tina Min Kulli Fajjin `Amiqin

v.t: That they may witness the benefits for themselves, and celebrate the name of God during the appointed days, for providing them with the animal livestock. So eat from it, and feed the unfortunate poor
v.l: Liyash/hadu Manafi`a Lahum Wa Yadhkuru Asma Allahi Fi 'Ayyamin Ma`lumatin `Ala Ma Razaqahum Min Bahimati Al-'An`am Fakulu Minha Wa 'At`imu Al-Ba'isa Al-Faqira

v.t: Then let them perform their acts of cleansing, and fulfill their vows, and circle around the Ancient House
v.l: Thumma Liyaqđu Tafathahum Wa Liufu Nudhurahum Wa Liattawwafu Bil-Bayti Al-`Atiqi

v.t: All that. Whoever venerates the sanctities of God—it is good for him with his Lord. All livestock are permitted to you, except what is recited to you. So stay away from the abomination of idols, and stay away from perjury
v.l: Dhalika Wa Man Yu`azzim Hurumati Allahi Fahuwa Khayrun Lahu `Inda Rabbihi Wa 'Uhillat Lakumu Al-'An`am 'Illa Ma Yutla `Alaykum Fajtanibu Ar-Rijsa Mina Al-'Awthani Wa Ajtanibu Qawla Az-Zuri

v.t: Being true to God, without associating anything with Him. Whoever associates anything with God—it is as though he has fallen from the sky, and is snatched by the birds, or is swept away by the wind to a distant abyss
v.l: Hunafa'a Lillahi Ghayra Mushrikina Bihi Wa Man Yushrik Billahi Faka'annama Kharra Mina As-Sama'i Fatakhtafuhu At-Tayru 'Aw Tahwi Bihi Ar-Rihu Fi Makanin Sahiqin

v.t: So it is. Whoever venerates the sacraments of God—it is from the piety of the hearts
v.l: Dhalika Wa Man Yu`azzim Sha`a'ira Allahi Fa'innaha Min Taqwa Al-Qulubi

v.t: In them are benefits for you until a certain time. Then their place is by the Ancient House
v.l: Lakum Fiha Manafi`u 'Ila 'Ajalin Musammaan Thumma Mahilluha 'Ila Al-Bayti Al-`Atiqi

v.t: We have appointed a rite for every nation, that they may commemorate God’s name over the livestock He has provided for them. Your God is One God, so to Him submit, and announce good news to the humble
v.l: Wa Likulli 'Ummatin Ja`alna Mansakaan Liyadhkuru Asma Allahi `Ala Ma Razaqahum Min Bahimati Al-'An`ami Fa'ilahukum 'Ilahun Wahidun Falahu 'Aslimu Wa Bashiri Al-Mukhbitina

v.t: Those whose hearts tremble when God is mentioned, and those who endure what has befallen them, and those who perform the prayer and spend from what We have provided for them
v.l: Al-Ladhina 'Idha Dhukira Allahu Wajilat Qulubuhum Wa As-Sabirina `Ala Ma 'Asabahum Wa Al-Muqimi As-Salaati Wa Mimma Razaqnahum Yunfiquna

v.t: We have made the animal offerings emblems of God for you. In them is goodness for you. So pronounce God’s name upon them as they line up. Then, when they have fallen on their sides, eat of them and feed the contented and the beggar. Thus We have subjected them to you, that you may be thankful
v.l: Wa Al-Budna Ja`alnaha Lakum Min Sha`a'iri Allahi Lakum Fiha Khayrun Fadhkuru Asma Allahi `Alayha Sawaffa Fa'idha Wajabat Junubuha Fakulu Minha Wa 'At`imu Al-Qani`a Wa Al-Mu`tarra Kadhalika Sakhkharnaha Lakum La`allakum Tashkuruna
w: the needy who do not ask

v.t: Neither their flesh, nor their blood, ever reaches God. What reaches Him is the righteousness from you. Thus He subdued them to you, that you may glorify God for guiding you. And give good news to the charitable
v.l: Lan Yanala Allaha Luhumuha Wa La Dima'uuha Wa Lakin Yanaluhu At-Taqwa Minkum Kadhalika Sakhkharaha Lakum Litukabbiru Allaha `Ala Ma Hadakum Wa Bashiri Al-Muhsinina

v.t: God defends those who believe. God does not love any ungrateful traitor
v.l: Inna Allaha Yudafi`u `Ani Al-Ladhina 'Amanu 'Inna Allaha La Yuhibbu Kulla Khawwanin Kafurin

v.t: Permission is given to those who are fought against, and God is Able to give them victory
v.l: Udhina Lilladhina Yuqataluna Bi'annahum Zulimu Wa 'Inna Allaha `Ala Nasrihim Laqadirun

v.t: Those who were unjustly evicted from their homes, merely for saying, “Our Lord is God.” Were it not that God repels people by means of others: monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques—where the name of God is mentioned much—would have been demolished. God supports whoever supports Him. God is Strong and Mighty
v.l: Al-Ladhina 'Ukhriju Min Diyarihim Bighayri Haqqin 'Illa 'An Yaqulu Rabbuna Allahu Wa Lawla Daf`u Allahi An-Nasa Ba`đahum Biba`đin Lahuddimat Sawami`u Wa Biya`un Wa Salawatun Wa Masajidu Yudhkaru Fiha Asmu Allahi Kathiraan Wa Layansuranna Allahu Man Yansuruhu 'Inna Allaha Laqawiyun `Azizun

v.t: Those who, when We empower them in the land, observe the prayer, and give regular charity, and command what is right, and forbid what is wrong. To God belongs the outcome of events
v.l: Al-Ladhina 'In Makkannahum Fi Al-'Arđi 'Aqamu As-Salaata Wa 'Ataw Az-Zakaata Wa 'Amaru Bil-Ma`rufi Wa Nahaw `Ani Al-Munkari Wa Lillahi `Aqibatu Al-'Umuri

v.t: If they deny you—before them the people of Noah, and Aad, and Thamood also denied
v.l: Wa 'In Yukadhibuka Faqad Kadhabat Qablahum Qawmu Nuhin Wa `Adun Wa Thamudu

v.t: And the people of Abraham, and the people of Lot
v.l: Wa Qawmu 'Ibrahima Wa Qawmu Lutin

v.t: And the inhabitants of Median. And Moses was denied. Then I reprieved those who disbelieved, but then I seized them. So how was My rejection
v.l: Wa 'Ashabu Madyana Wa Kudhiba Musa Fa'amlaytu Lilkafirina Thumma 'Akhadhtuhum Fakayfa Kana Nakiri

v.t: How many a town have We destroyed while it was doing wrong? They lie in ruins; with stilled wells, and lofty mansions
v.l: Faka'ayyin Min Qaryatin 'Ahlaknaha Wa Hiya Zalimatun Fahiya Khawiyatun `Ala `Urushiha Wa Bi'rin Mu`attalatin Wa Qasrin Mashidin

v.t: Have they not journeyed in the land, and had minds to reason with, or ears to listen with? It is not the eyes that go blind, but it is the hearts, within the chests, that go blind
v.l: Afalam Yasiru Fi Al-'Arđi Fatakuna Lahum Qulubun Ya`qiluna Biha 'Aw 'Adhanun Yasma`una Biha Fa'innaha La Ta`ma Al-'Absaru Wa Lakin Ta`ma Al-Qulubu Allati Fi As-Suduri

v.t: And they ask you to hasten the punishment. But God never breaks His promise. A day with your Lord is like a thousand years of your count
v.l: Wa Yasta`jilunaka Bil-`Adhabi Wa Lan Yukhlifa Allahu Wa`dahu Wa 'Inna Yawmaan `Inda Rabbika Ka'alfi Sanatin Mimma Ta`udduna
w: And they ask you to hasten

v.t: How many a town have I reprieved, although it was unjust? Then I seized it. To Me is the destination
v.l: Wa Ka'ayyin Min Qaryatin 'Amlaytu Laha Wa Hiya Zalimatun Thumma 'Akhadhtuha Wa 'Ilayya Al-Masiru

v.t: Say, “O people, I am only a plain warner to you.”
v.l: Qul Ya 'Ayyuha An-Nasu 'Innama 'Ana Lakum Nadhirun Mubinun

v.t: Those who believe and work righteousness—for them is forgiveness and a generous provision
v.l: Fa-Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Lahum Maghfiratun Wa Rizqun Karimun

v.t: But those who strive against Our revelations—these are the inmates of Hell
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Sa`aw Fi 'Ayatina Mu`ajizina 'Ula'ika 'Ashabu Al-Jahimi

v.t: We never sent a messenger before you, or a prophet, but when he had a desire Satan interfered in his wishes. But God nullifies what Satan interjects, and God affirms His revelations. God is Omniscient and Wise
v.l: Wa Ma 'Arsalna Min Qablika Min Rasulin Wa La Nabiyin 'Illa 'Idha Tamanna 'Alqa Ash-Shaytanu Fi 'Umniyatihi Fayansakhu Allahu Ma Yulqi Ash-Shaytanu Thumma Yuhkimu Allahu 'Ayatihi Wa Allahu `Alimun Hakimun

v.t: In order to make Satan’s suggestions a trial for those whose hearts are diseased, and those whose hearts are hardened. The wrongdoers are in profound discord
v.l: Liyaj`ala Ma Yulqi Ash-Shaytanu Fitnatan Lilladhina Fi Qulubihim Marađun Wa Al-Qasiyati Qulubuhum Wa 'Inna Az-Zalimina Lafi Shiqaqin Ba`idin

v.t: And so that those endowed with knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord, and so believe in it, and their hearts soften to it. God guides those who believe to a straight path
v.l: Wa Liya`lama Al-Ladhina 'Utu Al-`Ilma 'Annahu Al-Haqqu Min Rabbika Fayu'uminu Bihi Fatukhbita Lahu Qulubuhum Wa 'Inna Allaha Lahadi Al-Ladhina 'Amanu 'Ila Siratin Mustaqimin

v.t: Those who disbelieve will continue to be hesitant about it, until the Hour comes upon them suddenly, or there comes to them the torment of a desolate Day
v.l: Wa La Yazalu Al-Ladhina Kafaru Fi Miryatin Minhu Hatta Ta'tiyahumu As-Sa`atu Baghtatan 'Aw Ya'tiyahum `Adhabu Yawmin `Aqimin

v.t: Sovereignty on that Day belongs to God; He will judge between them. Those who believe and do good deeds will be in the Gardens of Bliss
v.l: Al-Mulku Yawma'idhin Lillahi Yahkumu Baynahum Fa-Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Fi Jannati An-Na`imi

v.t: But those who disbelieve and reject Our revelations—these will have a humiliating punishment
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Kafaru Wa Kadhabu Bi'ayatina Fa'ula'ika Lahum `Adhabun Muhinun

v.t: Those who emigrate in God’s cause, then get killed, or die, God will provide them with fine provisions. God is the Best of Providers
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Hajaru Fi Sabili Allahi Thumma Qutilu 'Aw Matu Layarzuqannahumu Allahu Rizqaan Hasanaan Wa 'Inna Allaha Lahuwa Khayru Ar-Raziqina

v.t: He will admit them an admittance that will please them. God is Knowing and Clement
v.l: Layudkhilannahum Mudkhalaan Yarđawnahu Wa 'Inna Allaha La`alimun Halimun

v.t: That is so! Whoever retaliates similarly to the affliction he was made to suffer, and then he is wronged again, God will definitely assist him. God is Pardoning and Forgiving
v.l: Dhalika Wa Man `Aqaba Bimithli Ma `Uqiba Bihi Thumma Bughiya `Alayhi Layansurannahu Allahu 'Inna Allaha La`afuwun Ghafurun

v.t: That is because God merges the night into the day, and He merges the day into the night, and because God is Hearing and Seeing
v.l: Dhalika Bi'anna Allaha Yuliju Al-Layla Fi An-Nahari Wa Yuliju An-Nahara Fi Al-Layli Wa 'Anna Allaha Sami`un Basirun

v.t: That is because God is the Reality, and what they invoke besides Him is vanity, and because God is the Sublime, the Grand
v.l: Dhalika Bi'anna Allaha Huwa Al-Haqqu Wa 'Anna Ma Yad`una Min Dunihi Huwa Al-Batilu Wa 'Anna Allaha Huwa Al-`Aliyu Al-Kabiru

v.t: Do you not see that God sends down water from the sky, and the land becomes green? God is Kind and Aware
v.l: Alam Tara 'Anna Allaha 'Anzala Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Fatusbihu Al-'Arđu Mukhđarratan 'Inna Allaha Latifun Khabirun

v.t: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. God is the Rich, the Praised
v.l: Lahu Ma Fi As-Samawati Wa Ma Fi Al-'Arđi Wa 'Inna Allaha Lahuwa Al-Ghaniyu Al-Hamidu

v.t: Do you not see that God made everything on earth subservient to you? How the ships sail at sea by His command? That He holds up the sky lest it falls on earth—except by His permission? God is Gracious towards the people, Most Merciful
v.l: Alam Tara 'Anna Allaha Sakhkhara Lakum Ma Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Al-Fulka Tajri Fi Al-Bahri Bi'amrihi Wa Yumsiku As-Sama'a 'An Taqa`a `Ala Al-'Arđi 'Illa Bi'idhnihi 'Inna Allaha Bin-Nasi Lara'ufun Rahimun

v.t: And it is He who gives you life, then makes you die, then revives you. The human being is unappreciative
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi 'Ahyakum Thumma Yumitukum Thumma Yuhyikum 'Inna Al-'Insana Lakafurun
w: He will cause you to die

v.t: For every congregation We have appointed acts of devotion, which they observe. So do not let them dispute with you in this matter. And invite to your Lord; you are upon a straight guidance
v.l: Likulli 'Ummatin Ja`alna Mansakaan Hum Nasikuhu Fala Yunazi`unnaka Fi Al-'Amri Wa Ad`u 'Ila Rabbika 'Innaka La`ala Hudaan Mustaqimin
w: So let them not dispute with you
So let them not dispute with you

v.t: But if they dispute with you, say, “God is fully aware of what you do.”
v.l: Wa 'In Jadaluka Faquli Allahu 'A`lamu Bima Ta`maluna

v.t: God will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection regarding what you disagree about
v.l: Allahu Yahkumu Baynakum Yawma Al-Qiyamati Fima Kuntum Fihi Takhtalifuna

v.t: Do you not know that God knows everything in the heavens and the earth? This is in a book. That is easy for God
v.l: Alam Ta`lam 'Anna Allaha Ya`lamu Ma Fi As-Sama'i Wa Al-'Arđi 'Inna Dhalika Fi Kitabin 'Inna Dhalika `Ala Allahi Yasirun

v.t: Yet they worship, besides God, things for which He sent down no warrant, and what they have no knowledge of. There is no savior for the transgressors
v.l: Wa Ya`buduna Min Duni Allahi Ma Lam Yunazzil Bihi Sultanaan Wa Ma Laysa Lahum Bihi `Ilmun Wa Ma Lilzzalimina Min Nasirin

v.t: And when Our Clear Verses are recited to them, you will recognize disgust on the faces of those who disbelieve. They nearly assault those who recite to them Our Verses. Say, “Shall I inform you of something worse than that? The Fire! God has promised it to those who disbelieve. And what a wretched outcome!”
v.l: Wa 'Idha Tutla `Alayhim 'Ayatuna Bayyinatin Ta`rifu Fi Wujuhi Al-Ladhina Kafaru Al-Munkara Yakaduna Yastuna Bial-Ladhina Yatluna `Alayhim 'Ayatina Qul 'Afa'unabbi'ukum Bisharrin Min Dhalikumu An-Naru Wa`adaha Allahu Al-Ladhina Kafaru Wa Bi'sa Al-Masiru

v.t: O people! A parable is presented, so listen to it: Those you invoke besides God will never create a fly, even if they banded together for that purpose. And if the fly steals anything from them, they cannot recover it from it. Weak are the pursuer and the pursued
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha An-Nasu Đuriba Mathalun Fastami`u Lahu 'Inna Al-Ladhina Tad`una Min Duni Allahi Lan Yakhluqu Dhubabaan Wa Lawi Ajtama`u Lahu Wa 'In Yaslubhumu Adh-Dhubabu Shay'aan La Yastanqidhuhu Minhu Đa`ufa At-Talibu Wa Al-Matlubu
w: and the one who is sought

v.t: They do not value God as He should be valued. God is Strong and Powerful
v.l: Ma Qadaru Allaha Haqqa Qadrihi 'Inna Allaha Laqawiyun `Azizun

v.t: God chooses messengers from among the angels, and from among the people. God is Hearing and Seeing
v.l: Allahu Yastafi Mina Al-Mala'ikati Rusulaan Wa Mina An-Nasi 'Inna Allaha Sami`un Basirun

v.t: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them. To God all matters are referred
v.l: Ya`lamu Ma Bayna 'Aydihim Wa Ma Khalfahum Wa 'Ila Allahi Turja`u Al-'Umuru

v.t: O you who believe! Kneel, and prostrate, and worship your Lord, and do good deeds, so that you may succeed
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Arka`u Wa Asjudu Wa A`budu Rabbakum Wa Af`alu Al-Khayra La`allakum Tuflihuna

v.t: And strive for God, with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you, and has not burdened you in religion—the faith of your father Abraham. It is he who named you Muslims before, and in this. So that the Messenger may be a witness over you, and you may be witnesses over the people. So pray regularly, and give regular charity, and cleave to God. He is your Protector. What an excellent Protector, and what an excellent Helper
v.l: Wa Jahidu Fi Allahi Haqqa Jihadihi Huwa Ajtabakum Wa Ma Ja`ala `Alaykum Fi Ad-Dini Min Harajin Millata 'Abikum 'Ibrahima Huwa Sammakumu Al-Muslimyna Min Qablu Wa Fi Hadha Liyakuna Ar-Rasulu Shahidaan `Alaykum Wa Takunu Shuhada'a `Ala An-Nasi Fa'aqimu As-Salaata Wa 'Atu Az-Zakaata Wa A`tasimu Billahi Huwa Mawlakum Fani`ma Al-Mawla Wa Ni`ma An-Nasiru
